267268245_d86b709e.text: Within the VMH, RNAscope ® labelling for Leprb mRNA revealed the majority of Leprb puncta were located in the dorsomedial and central subregions of the nucleus.This is consistent with the expression pattern described in the adult mouse brain 52,53 but differs slightly from Caron et al., 26 who reported that Leprb expression was greater in the dorsomedial and ventrolateral subregions when compared with the central subregion of the VMH at P10. 26
